subject: Hiring an office manager? This might save you the headache
body:
Hi,

Noticed Heartland Dental is hiring office managers across your supported locations — which usually means front desk capacity is stretched thin.

A big chunk of what office managers end up doing is answering phones, chasing missed calls, and manually booking appointments. Across 1,800+ offices, that adds up fast.

We build AI Receptionists for dental groups that handle all inbound calls 24/7, book appointments, and follow up on missed calls automatically. Clinics typically recover 20-40% of missed calls and see 10-25% more bookings — without adding headcount.

We also have an AI Outbound Agent that reaches new leads within 2 minutes and reactivates dormant patients from your CRM.

Would it make sense to chat for 15 minutes to see if it's a fit for Heartland?

Dylan Mitchell
dylan.realside@gmail.com
